goldenVerses.title: Golden verses
goldenVerses.intro: Pick multiple sub-tags from the same theme library as “Golden verse themes”. Saving writes the reference list and regenerates a static snapshot the shell reads at first paint (pinned translation text).
goldenVerses.themesLinkSuffix: to browse all tags and verse previews—this page only chooses which themes feed the home rotation.
goldenVerses.randomNote: On save, verses under the selected themes are deduped, shuffled, and capped at 400 refs. With nothing selected, the list is cleared and the home page falls back to the built-in default rotation. If you only edit external-home-verse-rotation.json by hand, run npm run generate:home-golden-verse-static from the repo root to refresh the static snapshot.

goldenVerseThemes.title: Golden verse themes
goldenVerseThemes.intro: Chinese topic tag wall (same bucketing as BIBLE/tag-wall). The local database stores no third-party provenance or outbound URLs—only tags, verse text, and Selah reader links. Run the import script to create data/scripture/reader-verse-themes.sqlite.

verseRepeatRank.intro: Sorted by theme-library tag frequency (~12,585 unique verses / 75,719 rows). The index stores only book, chapter, verse, and count; excerpts always come from Chinese Union (cuv-simp), not theme-library text. Passages split into one row per verse.

naturePage.intro: Manage full-screen background clips for Home and Nature: upload, square cover, and which clip is live. Video loops muted on the home page—ambient mix is no longer configured here.

journey.title: Journey
journey.lead: If this quiet suits you, keep walking.
journey.body: A lighter kind of company along the way—no rush, no checklist, a small steadier corner in the heart. What belongs here will meet you as you go; the still scenes and verses on home are already walking with you.

read.title: Scripture
read.body: Space for returning to the text—less noise, more room to dwell. If you stay on this path, it will join what you have already met in the verses on home.

read.tripleLoopEpochNote: By default, day 1 is 5 Apr 2026 (Easter); each track moves one chapter per day in OT · NT · Wisdom order. You can advance or reset to default on the chapter page.
read.tripleLoopPlansMeta: Three independent tracks · one segment each per day
read.tripleLoopTodaySummary: A short reading in Old Testament, New Testament, and Wisdom each; start with any track—progress stays separate.
read.tripleLoopPrinciple1: Tracks do not lock together; reading NT only advances the NT pointer.
read.tripleLoopPrinciple2: No catch-up days or “behind” messaging if you pause.
read.tripleLoopPrinciple3: After the last chapter of a track, that track restarts at the beginning.
read.tripleLoopActivateHint: When active, today's three segments default to the Easter epoch and our track order. Changes you make while reading are saved on this device.
read.tripleLoopAdvanceHint: Finished this section? Advance only “{{track}}” along our book order; the other two stay unchanged.

typography.contrastHint: Parallel text appears below each verse.
typography.chapterAudioVoiceHint: Teochew audio is available for the New Testament only; Old Testament chapters use Mandarin.

triple-loop.title: Three-track reading
triple-loop.subtitle: OT · NT · Wisdom
triple-loop.blurb: Three independent loops, one chapter (or Psalm) per track per day; no calendar catch-up. Gentle rhythm for staying with Scripture.

mcheyne.title: M'Cheyne reading plan
mcheyne.subtitle: 麦琴读经表
mcheyne.blurb: Four short readings per day in a pattern linked to M'Cheyne: OT once, NT and Psalms about twice in a year. Steady daily time helps. Chinese title above is a short guide; English labels stay authoritative for the slice boundaries.

backtothebiblechronological.title: Back to the Bible Chronological
backtothebiblechronological.subtitle: 按历史时间线读通圣经
backtothebiblechronological.blurb: A one-year chronological sweep, often weaving Job and other blocks by storyline. Good if you like reading along historical time. Copyright notes in the source appear in English.

esvchroniclesandprophets.title: Chronicles and Prophets
esvchroniclesandprophets.subtitle: 历代志与先知书
esvchroniclesandprophets.blurb: A track centered on Chronicles and the prophetic books—helpful for history-and-oracle threads. “ESV” in the name is a source label only.

esveverydayinword.title: Every Day In the Word
esveverydayinword.subtitle: 每日读经（叙事分块）
esveverydayinword.blurb: Several readings per day, often large narrative slices including cross-chapter spans. English labels help you match the upstream table exactly.

esvgospelsandepistles.title: Gospel and Epistles
esvgospelsandepistles.subtitle: 福音与书信
esvgospelsandepistles.blurb: A New-Testament-focused year through Gospels and letters—pair it with an OT plan if you like balance.

esvliterarystudybible.title: ESV Literary Study Bible Plan
esvliterarystudybible.subtitle: 文学研读圣经计划
esvliterarystudybible.blurb: Multiple readings per day from a literary-study style table. The ESV wording in the title is historical; your on-site Bible text follows the translation you import.

esvpentateuchandhistoryofisrael.title: Pentateuch and History of Israel
esvpentateuchandhistoryofisrael.subtitle: 五经与以色列历史
esvpentateuchandhistoryofisrael.blurb: Starts in the Torah and walks through Israel’s historical books—good if you want covenant and narrative spine first.

esvpsalmsandwisdomliterature.title: Psalms and Wisdom Literature
esvpsalmsandwisdomliterature.subtitle: 诗篇与智慧文学
esvpsalmsandwisdomliterature.blurb: Emphasizes Psalms and wisdom books—useful alongside more narrative-heavy schedules.

esvthroughthebible.title: Through The Bible
esvthroughthebible.subtitle: 按书卷顺序通读圣经
esvthroughthebible.blurb: One OT and one NT reading most days (often two passages), finishing the Bible in a year. We list one daily OT+NT plan to avoid near-duplicates.

heartlightotandnt.title: Heartlight OT and NT
heartlightotandnt.subtitle: Heartlight：旧约与新约并进
heartlightotandnt.blurb: One OT and one NT reading each day for balanced coverage without overloading a single testament.

oneyearchronological.title: One Year Chronological
oneyearchronological.subtitle: 一年编年通读（多段并行）
oneyearchronological.blurb: Chronological ordering; some days stack several passages to mirror parallel events—feel free to spread a heavy day across more than one sitting.

explore.title: Explore
explore.lead: More little surprises are quietly on their way.
explore.body: This corner will slowly fill with small delights—nothing to rush, worth returning to unwrap bit by bit. They are still traveling; if you can wait a little, you will meet them here soon. Until then, the verses and light on Home, a track in Music, or a short hush in Relax can be surprises that walk with you.
explore.availableHint: Wired-up entries appear below; the rest is still on its way.
explore.prayerCardLead: Pick a life situation, open a topic; verse text comes from your imported Bible.
